name: ADT A01 over HTTP (strict)
description: The golden adt-http profile: HL7 2.5.1, UTC, every ADT^A01 is a patient_admit, HOSP identifiers map to a placeholder OID. A message without a PV1 segment fails to parse.

name: ADT A01 over HTTP (tolerant)
description: The same golden profile with PV1 tolerated: a message without a PV1 segment parses with a MISSING_PV1 warning instead of failing.

name: ADT A01 by patient class
description: Classifies ADT^A01 by PV1-2 (I inpatient, E emergency, O outpatient, otherwise patient_admit) and reads unzoned timestamps as America/New_York.
